cohort: 60 participants with American Society of Anesthesiologists (ASA) physical status 1 and 2 scheduled for elective cesarean section under spinal anesthesia.
finding: Preemptive administration of 8mg intramuscular phenylephrine resulted in a significantly lower incidence of hypotension (20%) compared to 4mg (46.7%) during spinal anesthesia for cesarean section.
